core.title: Ambassador Lever with Premiere Rose, Weslock 1700B
tags: Weslock Ambassador Door Lever With Premiere Rosettes

text.description_html:
Weslock 1700B, Ambassador Lever with Ached Premiere Rose

The Ambassador Door Lever With Premiere Rose is adjustable to fit door thicknesses from 1-3/8 inches to 1-3/4 inches. The backset is also adjustable for either 2-3/8 inches or 2-3/4 inches with a removable faceplate. It is available in satin nickel and oil rubbed bronze finishes. Made by Weslock, the Ambassador Lever is available in dummy, privacy, passage, and keyed functions. The keyed and privacy functions offer emergency egress, which means that turning the interior lever immediately releases the lock. The Ambassador Lever with Permiere Rose has a certain elegance that gives off an air of richness.

This traditionally styled lever is from the Weslock Elegance Collection which features lifetime finish and mechanical warranties.

Features of the Ambassador Door Lever with Premiere Rose:

  • Keyed entry function meets ANSI A 156.2 Grade 2 cylindrical lock standards.
  • Rose and lever material: Solid Brass
  • Adjustable latches include removable faceplates.
  • 5-pin lock cylinder for entry function.
  • Removable door lever prevents scratching during installation.
  • Panic-proof keyed entry and privacy functions - one turn of interior lever unlocks and opens door.
  • Push-button locking rosette.
  • Limited Lifetime Mechanical Warranty
  • Limited 10 Year Finish Warranty
  • Fully ADA Compliant

Specifications of the Weslock Ambassador Door Lever with Premiere Rosette:

  • Lever Projection: 2-1/2"
  • Rose Style: Premiere
  • Rose Height: 5"
  • Rose Width: 2-1/2"
  • Door Thickness: adjustable from 1-3/8" to 1-3/4"
  • Backset: adjustable for either 2-3/8" or 2-3/4" with removable faceplate
  • Fits doors prepared with 2-1/8" cross hole and 1" edge hole

When Selecting a Function:

  • Dummy: For use as a pull or to match trim. Does not latch and does not lock.
  • Passage (hall or closet): For doors that don't need locking. Latches but does not lock. Door lever operates latch from either side of door.
  • Privacy (bedroom or bathroom): For doors that could need locking for privacy. Latch operates from either side. Push button on interior rose engages privacy lock; emergency release hole is on exterior rose. Turning inside lever will release privacy and retract latchbolt.
  • Keyed Entry (keyed lock): Use when a keyed lock is needed. Locked and unlocked by a key from the outside and push button on interior rose. Turning inside lever will release lock and retract latchbolt.

Sold Individually
